root_causes.title: Testcontainers dispose failure latches state before Docker removal completes
root_causes.description: Testcontainers .NET 4.13.0 latches Resource.Disposed before Docker resource removal completes. After a failed first DisposeAsync, retrying DisposeAsync on the same instance can return no-op success, so the Final Synthesis can release its handle while the actual container remains and its deterministic owner is lost.

root_causes.title: Digest assertion is not independent daemon-side evidence
root_causes.description: The digest assertion compares values parsed from the digest-qualified image reference passed to the Testcontainers builder. Pinning and the PostgreSQL runtime version check remain valid, but the assertion alone does not independently prove the running container's daemon-side digest.
